import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract features
features = [f for f in train.columns if f not in ["id", "target"]]

# Combine train and test for consistent encoding
all_data = pd.concat([train[features], test[features]], axis=0)
train_len = len(train)

# Handle high-cardinality f_27 with simple frequency encoding
f_27_counts = all_data["f_27"].value_counts()
f_27_encoding = f_27_counts.to_dict()
all_data["f_27_freq"] = all_data["f_27"].map(f_27_encoding).fillna(1)

# One-hot encode binary f_29 and categorical f_30
dummies_29 = pd.get_dummies(all_data["f_29"], prefix="f_29", drop_first=False)
dummies_30 = pd.get_dummies(all_data["f_30"], prefix="f_30", drop_first=False)
all_data = pd.concat([all_data, dummies_29, dummies_30], axis=1)

# Select features for model
feature_cols = [col for col in all_data.columns if col not in ["f_27", "f_29", "f_30"]]
train_features = all_data[:train_len][feature_cols].copy()
test_features = all_data[train_len:][feature_cols].copy()

target = train["target"].values

# Train/validate split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_features, target, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=target
)

# LightGBM model with reduced complexity
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=lgb_train)

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=100,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Validation score
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set and create submission
test_preds = model.predict(test_features)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "target": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved.")
